script.source:
//@version=5
indicator("uct-dmi-parity-v1", overlay=false)
[plusDI, minusDI, adx] = ta.dmi(14, 14)
plot(plusDI, title="plusDI")
plot(minusDI, title="minusDI")
plot(adx, title="adx")

provenance.note: Captured on a FRESH, disposable TradingView layout ('UCT Vendor Capture -- ADX TEMP', layout id MzVTX6lY) -- the SECOND disposable layout this program has created; the FIRST one ('UCT Vendor Capture -- Stoch TEMP', qAHjBkf4, used successfully for the prior Stoch batch) developed a persistent blank -chart-canvas rendering fault (title/OHLC/object-tree all correct, candles never painted, reproduced independently on two separate fresh-tab attempts) and was abandoned in place (never deleted, never diagnosed further) per explicit owner authorization -- see VENDOR_PARITY_TRANCHE_2_LANE_A_ADX_REPORT.md Appendix A. jHASRSzx itself was touched only through the single 'Manage layouts -> Create new layout' menu action, never modified further. 300 real trading-day bars (2025-06-27..2026-09-04), same window as the Stoch batch. Captured via a live [plusDI, minusDI, adx] = ta.dmi(14, 14) indicator, full double-precision CSV export (Table view -> Download data).

_vendor_parity_warmup_bars_note: True structural period-warmup is 14 bars (indices 0..13 have no UCT value at all). The chosen 170 is a conservative ROUND NUMBER past the empirically measured last-disagreement index (150 of 300) -- never the semantic period-warmup, and never silently equated with it. This is the SAME general capture-window cold-start effect already documented for rsi/atr/ema/rma/macd (divergences.json::recursive-smoother-cold-start-in-a-finite-capture): UCT's Wilder/RMA-style recursive smoothing (of +DM/-DM/TR, and for adx a SECOND smoothing pass over DX) re-seeds cold at this capture window's own first bar, while the real vendor value at every one of these calendar dates already reflects TradingView's continuous smoothing since SPY's real 1993 inception.
